item: Documented exception to p2/out/FINAL_manifest.json (closed v3.2 chain), approved by Micah Warren on Nov 15 2026 (option "documented exception")
cause: The first end-to-end WSL test run of kit_step4b (s1spec/kit4b_run_wsl1, Nov 15 12:45:40 PST) ran the tail stage B8 with the manifest cwd ../../s1_tight/consistency resolved outside the kit, i.e. the proof tree script /home/claude/s1_tight/consistency/check_outA5.py on the proof tree inputs, overwriting its output. Kit bug fixed in kit_step4b_v3 (stage cwd asserted inside the kit).
original: not recoverable (no copy exists; the file contains a timing field, so a rerun cannot restore the pinned bytes)
other_files: a find -newermt check of /home/claude showed no other proof-tree file modified by the run
scope: only this path; the closed manifest and all other pins are unchanged
